col_justimon.name: Blitz Arm
col_justimon.description: Duelist stance. Gains the Duelist trait and 30% attack speed. Its ability strikes the 2 nearest enemies several times and cuts their armor.

col_justimon.name: Critical Arm
col_justimon.description: Executioner stance. Gains the Executioner trait and 20% crit chance. Its ability hits the lowest-health enemy within 3 hexes, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and splashes adjacent enemies.

col_justimon.name: Trinity Arm
col_justimon.description: Juggernaut stance. Gains the Juggernaut trait and 400 HP. Its ability takes 50% less damage for 2 seconds, then smashes its target and everything around it.

col_labramon.name: Ballistamon
col_labramon.description: Tank partner. 20% more HP and 15 armor and MR. Its ability gains a shield, taunts nearby enemies and stuns them briefly.

col_labramon.name: Dorulumon
col_labramon.description: Diver partner. 30% more attack damage and 20% omnivamp. Its ability drills through to the lowest-health enemy, double damage below 50% HP.

col_labramon.name: Sparrowmon
col_labramon.description: Ranged partner. Attacks from 4 hexes with 25% more attack speed. Its ability gives it 50% attack speed for 5 seconds and fires at 3 enemies.

anessa.name: Anessa
anessa.title: Keeper of Secrets
anessa.core: A Demon Archer fights beside her (it falls when she does). She does not attack.

hob.name: Hob
hob.title: Fire Bug
hob.core: His attacks set enemies on fire.

jules.name: Jules
jules.title: Frost Brewer
jules.core: Gains 10 armor and magic resist for each unit next to him, friend or enemy.

enno.name: Enno
enno.title: Scavenger King
enno.core: Escape Artist: the first time he drops below 50% HP (and 25% from rank 4) he vanishes in smoke, shakes off stuns and burns, lands elsewhere and stuns enemies next to him.
